detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Fish It!: Sort the Aquarium Shop is a cozy organizing simulation. You've just stepped into a wildly chaotic aquatic store filled with 4,100+ unique fish swimming around where they shouldn't be. Pick up a fish, match it with its proper tank, and watch your messy shop transform into a peaceful, thriving aquarium paradise.

Dive Into the Chaos

Thousands of colorful fish have arrived all at once, turning your store upside down. Tropical swimmers, rare deep-sea species, and curious little water-dwellers are scattered everywhere. Your mission is simple: look at the fish, check the tank signs, and guide every single one back home.

Sort Fish, Earn Cash, and Expand

Every correctly placed fish rewards you right away with money. Use your earnings to fund powerful sorting upgrades that make your workflow smoother and faster. The more you organize, the more efficient your aquarium shop becomes.

Superpowers for the Ultimate Sorting

Spend your hard-earned money to unlock game-changing upgrade abilities:

  • Smart Throw: Thrown fish land right in the correct tank automatically.

  • Highlight Matching Fish: Makes matching fish glow so you can spot them instantly.

  • Highlight Shelf: Highlights the shelf your fish belongs to.

  • Fish Magnet: Pulls fish from anywhere on the map straight to your grasp.

  • Bulk Placement: Places every matching fish in one go.

From Total Mess to Order

Your store begins as a complete disaster zone. By filling the tanks one by one, you'll witness a deeply satisfying transformation. Bit by bit, the chaos fades away, leaving behind a pristine, perfectly organized hub of aquatic life.

No rushing. No stress. Just pure, relaxing sorting.

Key Features

🐠 Massive Variety: Sort over 4,100 unique fish into their correct natural habitats.

🏪 Cozy Store Management: Transform a chaotic aquatic shop into a stunning display.

💰 Rewarding Loop: Earn money for every sorted fish to fuel your progression.

⭐ Superpower Upgrades: Unlock abilities to carry more, move faster, and sort with ease.

🎮 Zero Pressure: Enjoy a relaxing, casual experience with no time limits or penalties.
